steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Phew. Doctor, it seems we've made it just in time for the tasting. Let's take part too.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Be my guests!

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: How's the flavor? I haven't made this properly since coming to Rhodes Island...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Nmh... mmh... fhh-fhah-hah...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Careful, Amiya, you'll burn yourself if you eat too fast.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It tastes... so good, with the chewy cheese, the crisp crust and the carrot both crunchy and sweet... it tastes exactly just like it used to.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: (Sigh of relief) I'm so glad to hear.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, come on, you try some too—

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Ah, one moment, Doctor. This portion's for you.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Specialized according to your tastes, slightly differently seasoning to suit you even better, I think.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Heheh! You like that kind of flavor, don't you? I tweaked the traditional methods a little, make your taste buds a happy camper.

options: You've got an incredible idea of my palate.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Only natural I do, my memory's strong stuff. The old Doctor's most favorite pie was flavored just like...

options: The old me liked this flavor too?
Seems like my taste's never slipped.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: S—Sorry. You don't remember it, do you, Doctor?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: I'm sorry, it's my fault. The moment I get careless I just start blurting out...

options: It's fine. There's nothing sorry about retaining nice memories.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Thank you, Doctor...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: See, the Doctor says it's fine too, Savage. Today's pie tastes just like the one from memory! I feel like the carrot's even tastier, on top of that.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: I've been practicing the whole time these last few years. Even though it was a completely solitary life, ha, haha...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: I'd share my pies out for my family, my coworkers and my neighbors to try when I made them.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The part of you that loves taking care of people hasn't changed a bit, Savage.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mmm, so sweet...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: There really is something different about Rim Billiton's local specialty carrots. We might've spent a lot of energy getting them, but we didn't go wrong in the end.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Strewth, it makes me angry just thinking about it. If it wasn't for those awful merchants...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Huh? Did something unsavory happen?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: I was dying to make carrot pie for all the Rhodes Islanders, and then we ended up trying for so long to buy any tinned Rim Billiton carrots...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Obviously I made a ginormous platter for my family just a month before I came, and then suddenly there's no tinned carrots on sale once I'm here? That just doesn't add up, does it?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: So, I went and consulted a very particular 'business expert'...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (It's Croissant, isn't it...)

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Only then did I learn, it was because of some Victorian merchants hyping up how Rim Billiton's carrots preserve your youth, keep you especially healthy, and are even surprisingly good for your skin...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Huh? Sure, everyone knows carrots keep you healthy, but, um, what exactly do they preserve...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: I thought it was ridiculous as well, but the 'expert' told me all the customers believe it hook, line and sinker now, thanks to that merchant hype.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Especially once they declared Rim Billiton carrots more effective than all the rest. Tins instantly went faster than people could buy them, and prices just sailed up and up...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: These carrots were a nightmare to get. I had to ask a favor of a neighbor's farm, if they could tin some carrots themselves and send them by post. It's all their own personal stock.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: I mean, really. What does all this weird promotion hope to accomplish in the end, eh—

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It truly is inscrutable... but merchants taking advantage of consumer mentality seems, um, like a reasonable occurrence.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Well, I was absolutely pissed off when I first heard the news!

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: These merchants, using rumors to drive up the price of a tin of Rim Billiton carrots, selling out a whole year's crop in advance, leaving even Rim Billitonians with not a tin themselves to eat...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: My 'expert' even mentioned how if the price flies too high, some more merchants'll crawl out and trick Rim Billiton's growers into switching all their crops to carrots...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Once the prices fall back down, then the carrots'll be impossible to sell.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: They've smashed up the farmers' own plans for growing self-sufficiently, and if they get hit by losses in future, they'll all be fuming with the merchants and they'll have to start resisting...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: And then we'll have another 'Cage Incident'-type mess!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: If rumors like these are left unchecked, things might turn very dangerous indeed.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Ah, have you heard someone else mention it before, Doctor?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's the point at which Rim Billiton's Autonomous County of Eureka established itself. The incident took place between three Rim Billiton cities, and the locals consider it a major event.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Might be a tough job to explain it in one dinnertime.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: To put it simply, it was a Victorian merchant lot who had an idea to make use of a small-scale nomadic city between two counties, so they could strike even more Rim Billiton ore.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: They steered that city's people into seizing the local ore, and then snatched it to take it off to Victoria for their own gains... The peak of sickness, ugh.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: So, the Incident part comes because the people lead the way, shake free of this fence the Victorian merchants set up called the 'Cage'...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: After that, they jointly establish an even more self-deciding Autonomous County of Eureka, and get control of the city back over to Rim Billiton. It was an amazing operation, if you ask me!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: During those times, Savage put in so much work to help the local people fight for their rights. She's a kind of minor celebrity in Rim Billiton.

options: Didn't expect something like that to happen.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: *cough*, *cough* *cough*. It wasn't that big a deal. I mean, with your wisdom and ability, Doctor, sorting out a dispute like that's probably a piece of cake...

options: Yep, just leave it to me.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Even so, the 'Cage Incident' clearly proves how the people of Rim Billiton are able to protect the land they're proud of, so why...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: That's what I'm saying! We've only had a few short years of peace, too... bloody hell, I just knew those merchants'd never follow trade conduct or any kind of standard routine.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But... Savage, your reaction says you have an idea of what to do already, don't you?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Heheh, that's my Amiya. Got me pegged down to a T.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: I've already had the Messenger send a letter to my old home's people, let them know they can't be even a mite careless.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: If they all change to carrot crops then they're bang in the merchants' trap. They've gotta talk it over with the farmers' union. Those lot aren't gonna just sit back and watch this situation unravel.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: We can't let irrational profits booms flip the underlying people's lives upside down... long and short is, we can't ever be controlled by merchants again!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Hehe. This is just like you, Savage.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Um... I mean how you act as swift as the wind—that part of you hasn't changed one bit!

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Well, of course! Who changes that easily? Just look, I dropped all my work to come sprinting over this way because I had you and the Doctor on my mind, too.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: That's true...!

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Essentially, customers buying Rim Billiton's tinned carrots should all be cheerily sampling the delicacies we're so proud of.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Fine food is a thing to make people feel happy, and not some kind of 'cure-all' sham!

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: We can't keep letting other regions' powers keep taking inches while dreaming of miles. Last it was Originium ore, now it's carrots... who knows what the next time'll be?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: They want our resources, and they want our local people offering up their lives. I just...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Even though I've left Rim Billiton, I just can't stomach looking on while they snatch away everything that never belonged to them, right off Rim Billiton's own land.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Savage...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Aww, don't look like that now. You don't need to worry about me.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Of course I'm not! I just think, you really do shine so brightly now.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Oh, even if I make a show of it, I can only actually do so little... I—I'm not the sort who can put my inside ideals into words, get other people standing firm in their own beliefs.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: ...But, y'know, Amiya, I'm a grown-up who's experienced a hell of a lot, too.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: What I know is, there's times... most times, when there's very little open for us to do. But doing something or other's always gonna beat the pants off just sitting here, watching things get worse.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: When you detect a crisis, you should snap to do something, or else trying to remedy a blown situation after the fact, you'll have no way to make back what's already been lost.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Mm, that's all. It's just some personal experience of mine, doing some of what I can. It's worth bounding about all over the place.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I can understand.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Amiya...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I can understand it. After all, Rhodes Island is just the same.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Eh, Rhodes Island too?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mmhm. I... we—have always persevered to do every little thing in our power.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's my belief that settling any one minor conflict helps us work towards our ultimate objective.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Couldn't have put it better myself! *sniff*—ah, hearing you say that makes me really happy...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Huh? Ah, did—did I say something wrong? Savage, don't cry, please don't cry!

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: You didn't! You didn't, you said it just right, I'm just—just a little moved.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: *sniffle*—When we parted before, you were still so little... and now you've become so... so incredible, already...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Wah! Calm down, Savage, calm down a little, don't hug me so tight... ugghh...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Truthfully, I was worried at the start too. I'd been away from you for so long. How would you react to how I've changed...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Heheh, you can relax on that front, Amiya.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: In my view, the leader of Rhodes Island eating Rim Billiton pie today's the same as you of the past, clinging to me all over Babel so I'd tell you stories. You're kind, adorable, modest, considerate of others—

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: You're someone I'm willing to share my strength and time with. You're the one I trust in, and the friend who most trusts in me.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Savage, I've finished eating.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Perfect. Tinned carrots have a best-by of forever, so I'll store them up properly, and next we have time for a party, I'll make you all another batch then.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: How's a monthly Rim Billiton Specialty Dish-Tasting Do sound?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Hehe, I'm already starting to look forward to it.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: That's right, Doctor, about just now...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Um... that is, about before...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Ah, I'll go and clean up the table.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I have some quite pressing work after this, so could I count on you to help Savage put away the surplus ingredients, Doctor?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'll be off, then. Sorry to trouble you, Doctor. At least you can have a nice chat with Savage.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Ah, Amiya, you don't need to go out of your way to—

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Off she runs. Honestly, the kid still keeps minding other people as much as ever.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Sorry, Doctor, could I take up a bit of your time? I invited Ansel and Rope to come taste too, but they'll be a bit late. The pie should be going in the oven more or less now.

options: Let me be your helper, then.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Mm-hm, thank you, Doctor.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: There's some things I want to talk to you about. We can go over it bit by bit while we're cooking.

options: Savage, how much do you understand of my past?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Just a very little scrap of it. The Doctor I saw...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Ah, no, no, I signed a confidentiality agreement with Kal'tsit, I can't talk about it!

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Actually, I don't even know what I can talk to you about, and what I can't.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: I don't understand the details, but I more or less get your situation from the chat I had with Miss Kal'tsit in advance, so I've been panicking this entire time if I'd leak something by accident.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: But seeing Amiya just like she used to be, still happily going around with you... I think, I'm gonna end up chatting about that stuff with you anyway!

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Fact is, thinking about it, I don't even have any secrets I can't tell you.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: My memories... aside from personalities being a bit different, the way you and Amiya get along hasn't changed, and the way Amiya and me get along hasn't changed. So, should be the same as before for you and me too.

options: Just what kind of person was I like before?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: A very mighty one, I'll have you know!

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Practically nothing you didn't know; you'd dispense an answer no matter what I asked you. Anything you forecast would end up happening, and when it came to commanding combat, you were even more...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Ah-ah, stop—no, can't say any more than that.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Ahem, basically... Doctor, you presented Amiya, me, and a whole lot of people who used to know you 'knowledge.'

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: There's a hell of a lot I couldn't teach Amiya. All I could do was be by her side for a while when she was young. But you, you were able to guide other people.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Oh, yeah! If I can't talk about the past when it has to do with you, I may as well mention what happened after you and I went our separate ways?

options: Yes, I'd be willing to hear.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Brilliant. Thank you, Doctor.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Once I was back in Rim Billiton back then, I heard nothing more about you or Amiya. But I trusted Amiya was doing her best to grow big, and you'd help her all along the way.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: But even if I never found Rhodes Island, found Amiya and you again, I still wouldn't have stayed at Rim Billiton PLC much longer.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Truth is, after I left Amiya and you, I returned to Rim Billiton itself.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Still ensuring workers' safety like ever, taking part in protection and rescue assignments, spending most of the time in the mines.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Rim Billiton's had its own fair share of going-ons these few years... bizarre things taking place more and more often, like the tinned carrot phenomenon.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Not only are other regions grubbing after Rim Billiton, but even in big cities who've always been peaceful, constant mining accidents have made it difficult to keep Infected numbers under control...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: And there's no way to ensure how they're treated.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: I can understand that whatever's pissing me off, my people off, is getting more frequent by the day. If I kept on under the PLC forever, I wouldn't have the leeway to sort out any of these changes for the unfair.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: After I returned to Rim Billiton, that was all the more clear to me. No matter if I dreamed of working away in my home all my life, this world of ours'd gradually come to forbid things go on so steady.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: So, I decided once and for all to change.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: My only option was to leave Rim Billiton, and figure out what was happening elsewhere across the land, before I could learn what kind of fate us Rim Billitonians might have. As well as... how to protect our peace.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: I suppose it was because my ability's pretty good? To tell the truth, I had a lot of other companies inviting me too.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: But... once I knew Rhodes Island's leader was Amiya, I came hopping over to this job without a second thought.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Since coming to Rhodes Island, I've been able to see so much more of the changes happening across the world.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: It's not just Rim Billiton. Every part of this whole grand stretch of land is gearing to change.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Maybe other places have their own people striving for change, but right now, the ones striving by my side for it... are Amiya, and you, Doctor.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: This place has hope. So, I'll do my part, for all of you.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Deciding to leave Rim Billiton was miles from easy. For us born-and-bred Rim Billitonians, leaving needs some groundbreaking courage.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: What supported me in leaving somewhere safe and easy was my determination, Amiya's determination—

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: And now, your determination, Doctor.

options: I've long since made my decision.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Right now... no matter what you've all gone through, or what you'll have to confront.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: I'll be going with you.
